about_the_game:
Instant action

Start a new run in a few seconds and get ready for intense post-apo warafare !

You start with a simple rifle filled with ammo and 100 health points and face you frist enemy very quickly.

Each time you clear a level :

  • you loot a new weapon (you can skip or equip)

  • you gain money

  • you choose a stat upgrade

The next level is harder : more ennemies, more life points, more danger.

Loot, loot, loot !

Rifles, guns, shotguns, flamme throwers and more.. each in 5 levels of quality.

Be fast, be accurate, don't loose health points : the loot will be generous !

Spend the earned money in powerfull capacities..

From the classic automatic turret to the artillery barrage request, spend the money you earn to help make the difference in the battlefiled !

.. or keep it for your next run !

Like any good roguelike, you won't start from scratch every time : improve your stats, unlock lootable weapons and abilities !

Do it solo.. or squad with friends !

The game is quite challenging on solo mode, but it becomes even more in coop.

Start a run with friends and test the limits of your friendship.. because the loot is unique ! More of that : the money is shared in the squad !
Feel like trolling ? Blow all the hard-earned squad money on the last enemy in a devastating and completely useless nuke.

name: Poly Frenzy

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A fast-paced and intense roguelike shooter in a ravaged world !In this low-poly third person shooter in a brutal post-apocalyptic universe, complete levels solo or in co-op, loot patched-up weapons, choose your upgrades and spend your money wisely on abilities that will make the difference !
